notes.title: July Bug Fix / Improvements Update
notes.notes:
We've got a small bug fix and improve update for folks, which aligns the Steam version with all of the updates from the recently launched mobile version.



With these fixes out of the way, we'll be turning out attention to some new content! We're in the prototype phase for a new brawler and will share some more detail soon. 



Thanks for all the love & support for Rustbowl Rumble!



IMPROVEMENTS

- Health previews in battle now show current health as well

- Slight increase to size of buff icon values



FIXES

- #1910: Cards like Weak Spot and similar will no longer be chosen for random card upgrades that aren't useful

- #1913: Fixed an issue where the town camera could have an incorrect zoom level if inspecting a unit while the battle is finishing

- #1914: Fixed a bug where Glowing perk didn't give bonus stamina as intended

- #1915: When resuming a game, cards in the shop are no longer missing their upgrades

- #1923: Block is now always consumed before armor

- #1924: Cards that grant energy now properly show a blue instead of a green lightning bolt icon

- #1926: Fixed an issue where entering a battle, exiting, and revisiting town would populate shops with different items

- #1927: Fixed a rare issue where buying perks could cause money to go negative

- #1928: Dealing damage with Mischief after completing her Bad Apple perk should apply the correct amount of poison

- Fix a few memory leaks to improve performance in longer sessions

notes.title: Bug Fix Update - May 2
notes.notes:
IMPROVEMENTS
- Tapa's starting deck has been updated with Tapa specific cards / mods

BUGS
- Fixed a bug where Big Bang Theory wasn't properly counting upgrades as part of the achievement conditions
- Peaceful should properly trigger if no cards are played, even while using perks like Guerilla which add a 'default attack'
- Fixed a bug where achievements like Super Strength were not achieved. If you previously tried to achieve this, you will need to meet the conditions again.
- Fixed an issue where some players were unable to get achievements for unlocking certain heroes. Visit the 'Unlocks' page on main menu to sync your state and get credit for those achievements

BALANCE
- Goobernaut's perk will no longer target heroes that use curses

notes.title: Update noteos for April 3
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue where some wired controllers would sometimes 'fight' for input while trying to use a mouse
- Other minor bug fixes

notes.title: First Patch: Bug Fixes, Improvements, and Balance
notes.notes:
First patch is a small one to address a few bugs that were reported by the community (especially those with the most negative impact), as well as a few minor balance updates. 

Lastly, on Iron+ difficulty, you'll get to choose which vendors you want to visit rather than having to restart if you don't like your choices in town.

Patch Notes

IMPROVEMENTS
- When starting a run in Iron+ (or higher), you'll now get to choose a schedule to start your run

BUGS
- Cutscenes now respect master volume setting
- Fixed a crash related to the Swampalina boss fight
- The 'Peaceful' feat should now trigger properly, even if a minion attacks
- The Sharpen effect from 'Salvage' now triggers feats such as 'May the Forge Be With You'
- Fixed a softlock related to the Two Face feat and the perk Flash mob
- Fixed a softlock related to the Guerilla perk and Large and In Charge wild card

BALANCE
- Reduced difficulty of Waggu and Sludgehammer boss fights on Iron+ league
- Round timer adds 4 rounds when you complete a wave (up from 3)

Future Updates

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137979/912a587ee52f5634a71eebea508bb54cde2b5233.png

We've got more content planned for Bramble in the coming months, including new heroes and new cards. Other possibilities include new difficulty levels, etc. Let us know in the comments what type of content you'd most like to see!

notes.title: Bramble Royale - Status Update
notes.notes:
As the first post for Bramble Royale, I wanted to share an overview of where things are at and what else is on the roadmap before the 1.0 release early next year.

Where are things at?
It's been a LONG journey (more on that in a future post!) but the game is largely defined and playable end-to-end. 6 of the 8 characters are ~90% implemented in terms of cards (animations are completed). 

All of the major systems are present in the game. That includes card upgrades, town vendors, combat sytesm and more. The frameworks required for achievements and localization are completed, but more work will be required there before launch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137979/1c124fb6e17526b5f0128146292399e421344d94.png

Current Focus
Our current top priority is shipping an initial demo. We're eager to share a taste of Bramble of fans, as well as get some early gameplay and technical feedback on the game. We also know that demos are a really effective tool and generating interest and wishlists and hype.

Additionally, before the demo releases, we want to complete controller / Steam Deck support. Playing on Steam Deck is our favorite way to play and we want to make it's perfect before Bramble's first introduction to the community.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137979/a62cb44e8661be41b1f5525180363fb7654501ed.jpg

What else is left?
After the demo launch in the next month or so, we'll be focused on the long tail of stuff that you need to do in order to launch a game.


 Intro cinematic
 Content (heroes, enemies, cards, perks, etc... )
 More voice overs
 NG+ levels
 Card / item artwork
 Localization
 Steam Cloud & Achivement integration

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137979/a6ff53e0c83ea6e5023c0d503df1d863da930576.jpg

As you can see there is still a lot of work to do! This is one of the absolute toughest phases of development, where the game feels almost complete in some ways, but where you need to put in A LOT of work to get that last little bit done. The end result is what separates Very Positive from Overwhelmingly Positive games.

I'm excited to be on this journey and can't wait to share more with you soon!
